Senior Growth Product Manager – Adobe Experience Cloud

The Opportunity

Adobe Experience Cloud enables enterprises to deliver personalized, data-driven digital experiences at scale. We are seeking a Senior Growth Product Manager to drive Product-Led Growth (PLG) across Experience Cloud products by accelerating user acquisition, activation, engagement, retention, and expansion.

This role is ideal for a growth leader with deep experience in B2B SaaS and Digital Marketing Technology, who thrives at the intersection of product, experimentation and data. You will drive and implement growth strategies across key user journeys, partnering closely with Engineering, Design, Data Science, and Go-To-Market teams to turn customer insight into scalable growth engines.

What You’ll Do

Growth Strategy & Lifecycle Management

  • Drive and evolve end-to-end growth strategies across acquisition, activation, engagement, retention, and expansion for an Experience Cloud product.
  • Identify and prioritize high-impact growth opportunities using data, research and experimentation.
  • Develop and prioritize a growth roadmap tied to clear business impact.

Experimentation & Optimization

  • Design, launch, and analyze a high-velocity experimentation program across critical user journeys.
  • Drive rapid test-and-learn cycles that ensure rigorous experiment design by establishing clear hypotheses, calculating statistical power, and implementing appropriate guardrails.
  • Collaborate with engineering and data teams to build robust instrumentation for accurate measurement and monitoring. Oversee careful rollout strategies—including phased launches, A/B testing, and control groups—to minimize risk and improve actionable insights.

Technology-Based Growth Initiatives

  • Identify, prioritize, and ship product experiences powered by advanced technology that improve conversion and retention—e.g., personalization, predictive mentorship, and intelligent onboarding.
  • Use AI to speed up experiment ideation, hypothesis generation, copy/variant drafting, and analysis—while maintaining statistical rigor and human review.

Cross-Functional Collaboration

  • Partner with cross-functional leaders to co-develop and implement growth initiatives, navigating trade-offs and driving alignment across teams
  • Proven ability to influence product roadmaps and drive outcomes in a matrixed environment without direct authority
  • Strong stakeholder management skills, with experience aligning multiple teams around shared goals

Work in close coordination with:

  • Product Leaders who own core product to co-develop and implement a growth roadmap
  • Engineering to implement experimentation infrastructure
  • Design & UX Research to optimize onboarding and feature discovery
  • Marketing to align product growth levers with acquisition strategies
  • Finance & Data Science to quantify business impact

What You Need to Succeed

  • 5+ years of Growth Product Management experience, with significant focus on experimentation-driven optimization.
  • Proven experience driving B2B Product-Led Growth in SaaS or Digital Marketing Technology platforms.
  • Experience implementing and executing experimentation tools.
  • Deep expertise in experimentation frameworks, behavioral analytics, funnel optimization, and cohort analysis.
  • Solid understanding of enterprise customer journeys, including self-serve, sales-assisted, and hybrid motions.
  • Fluency in applying AI to product discovery, experimentation, and growth workflows, with a commitment to continuous skill development.
  • Hands-on experience using AI-assisted tools for accelerating prototyping and insight generation.
  • Demonstrated ability to translate data and customer insight into shipped product experiences with measurable impact.
  • Excellent communication skills, with the ability to synthesize insights into clear narratives that drive action.

Most Importantly

You value outcomes over activity, learning over certainty, and are deeply customer obsessed. You believe Product-Led Growth is an operating model, not a feature, and you thrive in environments where experimentation, insight, and collaboration drive impact.

If this sounds like you, we’d love to have you help shape the future of Experience Cloud.

The Opportunity

Join Adobe’s Digital Experience organization in Bengaluru as a Product Manager 3 and lead one of our most important enterprise capabilities. You will manage forecasting within a connected ecosystem that includes Sales Performance Management, Forecasting, and upstream planning systems. This provides a single, reliable view of pipeline and ARR forecasts, which directly supports executive decision-making. This outstanding opportunity lets you join a world-class team and make a meaningful impact!

What You’ll Do

  • Take full responsibility for Sales Performance Management and forecasting systems from start to finish

  • Improve forecast accuracy, pipeline coverage, and predictability through data insights
  • Work with engineering teams to bring to bear AI/ML, LLMs, or automation frameworks (e.g., copilots, agents, orchestration tools)
  • Proven capability to outline, convey, and secure agreement on multi-year product roadmaps for platform or enterprise products

Skills Required

  • 6–8 years in Product Management, ideally within Sales Performance Management, Forecasting, RevOps, or related platforms
  • Experience owning complex, multi-system enterprise products or SPM and Forecasting platforms
  • Strong comprehension of sales pipeline oversight, sales performance tracking, and forecasting procedures
  • Strong experience partnering with engineering, architecture, and operations teams in Agile/Scrum environments
  • Experience managing complex, multi-system initiatives through disciplined prioritization and execution
  • Strong data and analytical abilities with experience working on data models, pipelines, and forecasting inputs
  • Proven ability to drive cross-functional alignment and roadmap execution at scale

Requirements & Product Discovery

  • Strong ability to elicit, structure, and validate business requirements through interviews, workshops, and discovery sessions with collaborators, customers, and other interested parties
  • Experience conducting fit-gap analysis (current vs. future state) to define MVP scope and strategic roadmap
  • Ability to challenge and refine requirements to ensure alignment with business value, outcomes, and scalability

Documentation & Communication

  • Expertise in crafting clear, structured product artifacts, including:

Product Requirements Documents (PRDs)

1. Business Requirements Documents (BRDs)

Process flows, journey maps, and personas

  • Ability to detail end-to-end business processes and system interactions, including downstream impacts across coordinated platforms
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to convey complex concepts clearly to both technical and non-technical audiences

Backlog Management & Delivery Readiness

  • Proven experience translating requirements into epics, features, and user stories with clear acceptance criteria
  • Strong backlog ownership, including prioritization, refinement, and sprint readiness
  • Ability to outline test scenarios and UAT criteria, ensuring delivered features meet business expectations
  • Familiarity with Agile methodologies and tools (e.g., Jira, Workfront)

Cross-Functional Leadership & Alignment

  • Ability to lead and influence across Sales, RevOps, Finance, Engineering, and Architecture without direct authority
  • Experience driving alignment on scope, priorities, and definitions across complex collaborator groups
  • Comfortable presenting to and influencing senior leadership and governance forums (e.g., PRB/ARB)

Analytical & Problem-Solving

  • Strong capability to detect problems in data, process, or system build
  • Experience using data to drive product decisions, prioritization, and continuous improvement
  • Ability to recognize root causes of business and system challenges and convert them into actionable solutions

Execution & Operational Excellence

  • Experience managing products through full lifecycle (discovery → definition → delivery → release → optimization)
  • Strong focus on detail with the capability to handle dependencies, risks, and delivery schedules
  • Ability to balance run-the-business priorities with central initiatives

The Opportunity 

We are seeking a stellar individual for a high-impact role focused on defining monetization strategy within Adobe’s Creativity and Productivity business segment (historically referred to as Digital Media and home to such premier products as  Creative Cloud,  Acrobat,  Photoshop, Illustrator and Firefly).  We are a highly visible team responsible for making strategic recommendations that have a significant financial impact.    

Our team leads development and refinement of Adobe’s monetization strategy, including monetization of GenAI and emerging agentic capabilities across segments and routes-to-market.  We do this by driving initiatives that optimize new and existing offerings via product innovation, product line determination, business model refinement, and changes to offering and pricing strategy.  

As such, the right candidate will find this to be a strong foundation for growth and an outstanding opportunity to have a material impact on the business.    

What You’ll Do 

This particular role will focus on developing pricing and packaging strategies to address the needs of individual customers across our Firefly suite of offers. Work will also involve determining the pricing of generative AI tools available for individual customers across both Firefly & Creative Cloud products.  This may involve the following activities: ​

  • Support defining and optimizing monetization strategy for Firefly Individual offers, including defining portfolio optimizations strategies and recommending enhancements to product roadmaps and configurations  

  • Continuously determine how to best monetize newly developed generative AI features, adding them to our credit rate cards where necessary 

  • Develop and conduct qualitative customer research 

  • Design and complete quantitative market research including one or more of the following research methods: Build-Your-Own Conjoint, Discrete Choice Conjoint, Gabor-Granger 

  • Collect, synthesize and analyze industry and competitor data 

  • Develop financial models that simulate customer behavior and project costs to complete scenario analysis that estimates the impact of proposals on market penetration, company revenues and margin 

  • Develop and present arguments that articulate the strategy and return-on-investment in order to acquire and incorporate cross-functional feedback and ultimately achieve executive approval 

We also ensure smooth execution of our proposals. 

  • Engage with engineering, finance, and operational teams to ensure that proposed monetization strategies can be implemented within existing commerce systems, balancing proposals between theoretical monetization potential vs. operational complexity and practicality 

  • Collaborate with Product Management and Product Marketing teams to define product roadmaps to better support monetization goals 

  • Complete post-mortems to ensure proposals are successful and/or refine.

​What You’ll Need to Succeed

We are looking for an analytical wiz with high initiative, a strategic approach and quantitative talent. 

  • 3+ years of proven experience crafting pricing and packaging strategies and successfully bringing them to market in a complex matrixed organization.  

  • Understanding of emerging GenAI capabilities and their practical application across business processes, customer experiences and operational workflows. 

  • The ability to simplify the complex, quickly define the core problem and frame the solution approach. 

  • Attention to detail balanced by comfort with ambiguity. 

  • Excellent deck-writing, communication, and upward-influencing skills. 

  • Strong EQ and leadership ability.  

  • Intellectual curiosity. 

  • Experience driving consensus in a large matrixed organization.  

  • A background in strategy consulting, product management, product marketing, and/or change-management, ideally in software/technology, are all big pluses.

The Opportunity

International Strategy and Product Management (ISPM) is responsible for creating exceptional product experience worldwide. We drive discovery, adoption, and growth of our Creative Cloud (CC) and Document Cloud (DC) products in new markets.

We are seeking a Product Manager to lead the international expansion and adoption of DC's AI-powered agentic products and services. You will collaborate cross-functionally with engineering, marketing, GTM, and local sales teams to drive our international product strategy. You will guide the product roadmap and prioritization, create market-ready experience, and measure impact. You will help the teams strike the right balance between scalable and local!

This is a high visibility position with responsibility for developing strategic product level recommendations that have substantial subscription unit and financial impact. As such, it provides significant professional development and excellent growth potential for the right person. As Adobe's vision for agentic workflows becomes a reality, this role requires deep customer empathy, strong market knowledge across key verticals, and the ability to uncover insights from user workflows to drive product innovation and growth.

What you'll Do

  • Define product vision, strategy, and roadmap for GenAI-powered experiences, driving measurable business outcomes across priority international markets.

  • Leverage user, product, financial, competitive, and market insights to build data-driven product strategy, prioritize investments, and secure executive alignments across key international markets.

  • Drive validation of end-to-end use cases, user journeys, and workflows to identify internationalization gaps, establish product readiness criteria, and prioritize opportunities for expansion into new markets.

  • Partner with engineering, build, marketing, GTM, sales, and regional collaborators to align priorities and drive successful product execution.

  • Define success metrics and monitor product performance to measure impact, inform decisions, and continuously optimize market outcomes.

What you'll need to succeed

  • 3-5+ years of experience in product management, software development, or management consulting.

  • Proven track record of defining product requirements and delivering successful products. Experience launching products or services from concept to 1.0.

  • Demonstrable GenAI proficiency, ongoing AI skill development, and staying current with emerging AI technologies. Experience building AI-native products or GenAI powered products is a strong plus.

  • Experience engaging directly with customers across B2C and B2B environments, building positive relationships, uncovering needs, and incorporating customer insights into product strategy and execution. Experience in user experience survey, interview, and research tools (Qualtrics, UserTesting).

  • Ability to operate effectively in ambiguous, resource-constrained environments, creating clarity and momentum across multiple partner workstreams simultaneously

  • Passion for sports, fan engagement, or commercial brand marketing, with genuine interest in how major sports and commercial organizations build digital fan/customer experiences

  • Experience with embedded SDKs, platform APIs, or white-label product models

  • Understanding of GenAI-powered content creation and its application to fan engagement or personalized commercial experiences

About Frame.io Frame.io is changing the future of how videos are made by helping over 1 million creative professionals seamlessly collaborate from all over the world. Our mission is to power the world's video creation. We pour our soul into the Frame.io product to delight customers and make it easier for them to realize that mission. About the role As the product leaders of Frame.io, it is our job to ship the right product to the high standards we expect of ourselves, and to track its success after launch. We understand that a product isn't finished when it goes out the door. We're looking for a product manager with relevant experience to join us. You'll be focused on Frame.io's core identity framework and the integration into Adobe's identity systems. What you'll do Define and improve identity-related user experiences, including authentication, account linking, migration flows, and admin-facing workflows Work closely with Design, Engineering, Product, Sales, Legal, Security, Customer Support, Marketing and Leadership to rapidly identify and validate product opportunities Break down product opportunities into clear, concrete units of work that can be used to support delivery Specify the appropriate sequence and relative priority of product opportunities Lead project management with your squad and external customers to ensure smooth product launch Bring to bear data, strategic insight and context to influence team members and build consensus for key decisions Positively contribute to Product Team culture and support peers or more junior Product Managers where appropriate What you need to succeed 2+ years of formal Product Management experience with identity, SaaS user management, authentication, permissions, provisioning, admin, or migration workflows. Knowledge of B2B authentication and SSO flows are desired but not required. Experience in large scale data migrations within or across products, preferably involving identity data You understand that identity product decisions carry security, privacy, compliance, and customer-trust implications, and you know when to bring Legal, Security, and enterprise stakeholders into the decision process. You've taken an idea from its initial brief to design to development to QA to release. You're at ease project managing a product through this process and how to ensure that release dates are met You are capable of making sound decisions with incomplete/ imperfect data, have experience assessing tradeoffs, thoughtfully prioritize, and move quickly on decisions You communicate well. You explore your ideas through concise and thoughtful writing. You understand that half of the job is making sure the organization knows what your team is working on and how it will affect them You're customer empathetic. You constantly look for ways to build customer understanding, whether through customer interviews or jumping into the support queue to solve real customer problems You’re technically fluent. You can work with engineers to understand how identity data is modeled, how it flows through our systems, and where product decisions create technical tradeoffs, while leaving implementation details to engineering You're a data-informed problem solver. You build hypotheses, test them with qualitative and quantitative evidence, and use tools like Amplitude, SQL, and Looker to understand whether a product decision achieved its intended outcome. full_job_description_raw:
About Frame.io
Frame.io is changing the future of how videos are made by helping over 1 million creative professionals seamlessly collaborate from all over the world.
Our mission is to power the world's video creation. We pour our soul into the Frame.io product to delight customers and make it easier for them to realize that mission.
About the role
As the product leaders of Frame.io, it is our job to ship the right product to the high standards we expect of ourselves, and to track its success after launch. We understand that a product isn't finished when it goes out the door.
We're looking for a product manager with relevant experience to join us. You'll be focused on Frame.io's core identity framework and the integration into Adobe's identity systems.
What you'll do

  • Define and improve identity-related user experiences, including authentication, account linking, migration flows, and admin-facing workflows
  • Work closely with Design, Engineering, Product, Sales, Legal, Security, Customer Support, Marketing and Leadership to rapidly identify and validate product opportunities
  • Break down product opportunities into clear, concrete units of work that can be used to support delivery
  • Specify the appropriate sequence and relative priority of product opportunities
  • Lead project management with your squad and external customers to ensure smooth product launch
  • Bring to bear data, strategic insight and context to influence team members and build consensus for key decisions
  • Positively contribute to Product Team culture and support peers or more junior Product Managers where appropriate

What you need to succeed

  • 2+ years of formal Product Management experience with identity, SaaS user management, authentication, permissions, provisioning, admin, or migration workflows. Knowledge of B2B authentication and SSO flows are desired but not required.
  • Experience in large scale data migrations within or across products, preferably involving identity data
  • You understand that identity product decisions carry security, privacy, compliance, and customer-trust implications, and you know when to bring Legal, Security, and enterprise stakeholders into the decision process.
  • You've taken an idea from its initial brief to design to development to QA to release. You're at ease project managing a product through this process and how to ensure that release dates are met
  • You are capable of making sound decisions with incomplete/ imperfect data, have experience assessing tradeoffs, thoughtfully prioritize, and move quickly on decisions
  • You communicate well. You explore your ideas through concise and thoughtful writing. You understand that half of the job is making sure the organization knows what your team is working on and how it will affect them
  • You're customer empathetic. You constantly look for ways to build customer understanding, whether through customer interviews or jumping into the support queue to solve real customer problems
  • You’re technically fluent. You can work with engineers to understand how identity data is modeled, how it flows through our systems, and where product decisions create technical tradeoffs, while leaving implementation details to engineering
  • You're a data-informed problem solver. You build hypotheses, test them with qualitative and quantitative evidence, and use tools like Amplitude, SQL, and Looker to understand whether a product decision achieved its intended outcome.

title: Senior Product Manager, Growth

description:
The Opportunity Adobe's data platform is a vertical data intelligence stack: raw signals are governed and routed at ingestion, enriched and catalogued into curated enterprise definitions, and ultimately transformed into retrieval-ready, agent-optimized knowledge assets. The knowledge tier sits at the top of that stack. Curated definitions become trustworthy, retrieval-ready knowledge. AI agents, self-service analytics, and enterprise decision systems consume this knowledge every day. As Senior Product Manager for this layer, you own its execution throughout the entire process. This includes how knowledge assets are modeled, published, maintained, and delivered to consuming agents via retrieval and integration interfaces. You'll turn a multi-quarter roadmap into shipped capabilities, working shoulder-to-shoulder with engineering, data science, and peer platform PMs. This is a builder's role at the sharp end of Adobe's agent-ready data strategy. What you'll own Own the product roadmap — develop and drive a 6–12 month roadmap for knowledge-asset modeling, retrieval APIs, agent-integration interfaces, and embedding/RAG pipelines, prioritizing and re-prioritizing against shifting platform needs. Lead delivery from inception to launch — provide project leadership and day-to-day management spanning engineering and build, making thoughtful quality / customer-value / time-to-market tradeoffs and mitigating risk. Own knowledge freshness and lifecycle — define how curated definitions are ingested, versioned, deprecated, and kept current, so consuming agents never retrieve stale or orphaned knowledge. Deliver the trust signals for the knowledge layer —freshness, lineage, and quality—so knowledge assets can be safely consumed by agents, while contributing these signals to the platform-wide agent readiness score. Build human-in-the-loop correction workflows at the knowledge layer — define what triggers human review of a knowledge asset, and how corrections propagate to downstream consumers. Write clear engineering PRDs — translate platform requirements into prioritized features, crisp specifications, and concrete performance measures and safety thresholds. Partner across the platform team — align with peer PMs owning metadata, event telemetry, and cross-cutting governance so retrieval and embedding surfaces are built on governed, trustworthy foundations. Prototype to think — use vibe-coding (Claude Code preferred) to stand up quick, testable prototypes that reduce risk in build choices ahead of engineering dedication. What you require to succeed Track record: 7+ years of product management experience, including 2+ years owning a data platform, data infrastructure, or enterprise data product end to end — not just contributing to one. AI knowledge-stack fluency: Working knowledge of knowledge-graph concepts, embedding pipelines, RAG architectures, MCP servers, and agent skills, plus a working understanding of how agents and models consume data and what makes an asset "agent-ready." Quality workflows: Experience with human-in-the-loop quality and correction workflows in production data systems. Specification skill: Ability to write engineering PRDs that translate complex technical systems into clear user problems, prioritized features, and measurable success metrics and guardrails. Rapid prototyping: Ability to design and build quick prototypes through vibe-coding (Claude Code preferred) to de-risk decisions before engineering invests. Systems thinking and business judgment: able to reason about the platform as a causal chain rather than independent features, and to articulate how a decision drives adoption, retention, and downstream platform value. Cross-functional influence: Proven ability to drive cross-functional delivery across engineering and program through influence rather than authority, with comfort operating at ambiguous (roadmap) and precise (specification) altitudes simultaneously. description:
The Opportunity Adobe is building Firefly Foundry, the platform for customizing any media model at any depth. It spans image, video, audio, and multi-modal models, Adobe’s own and third-party alike, so all of it happens in one place. From keeping a marketing team on-brand without touching a model, to training a model that generates a studio’s characters at production quality, Firefly Foundry lets enterprises work at whatever depth the problem calls for. We are seeking a Director of Product Management to help lead the Firefly Foundry product organization. You will drive product strategy and roadmap for key areas of the platform and partner closely with engineering, AI research, design, forward-deployed teams, product marketing, and go-to-market. This is a rare opportunity to help shape a net-new, AI-first enterprise platform at global scale — defining how the world’s brands, studios, and developers customize, govern, and deploy generative media models, and how Firefly Foundry becomes an essential surface for enterprise AI media. What you’ll do Drive product strategy and roadmap for core areas of Firefly Foundry, spanning the platform’s levels of customization — from shared brand context and prompt intelligence to self-serve model tuning and managed franchise-model training. Identify high-impact opportunities, prioritize features, define success metrics, and own end-to-end delivery across a multi-model, multi-modal platform. Build a platform that lets customers start at any level of customization and go deeper as the work changes, so nothing they build at one level gets stranded when they move to the next. Translate complex model-customization capabilities — fine-tuning, evals, version history, prompt intelligence, and IP guardrails — into clear, self-serve product experiences for enterprise teams. Partner closely with engineering, AI research, design, and forward-deployed creative technologists, engineers, and research scientists to cut the time from an idea to a model running in production. Shape how Firefly Foundry is consumed: direct API access for customers’ own applications, pipelines, and agents, and native experiences inside Firefly Studio and the Creative Cloud apps teams already use. Own the trust layer as a first-class product surface — safety classifiers, jailbreak and prompt-injection defenses, copyright indemnity, data isolation, and the compliance and certifications customers inherit. Contribute to Foundry’s model-agnostic strategy and token economics, keeping the best available base model one contract-free switch away for every customer. Share product vision inside and outside Adobe, gathering feedback from enterprise customers, partners, and internal teams to guide direction. Mentor and support product managers on the team, setting a high bar for product craft, ownership, and execution. What you’ll need to succeed 8 or more years of product management experience, including leading complex, multi-surface or platform products. A strong understanding of generative media models (image, video, audio, and multi-modal) and model customization — fine-tuning, evaluation, and prompt engineering. Experience building enterprise or developer platforms — APIs, SDKs, or infrastructure products serving both technical and business users. Experience leading product in a matrixed organization and influencing across engineering, research, design, services, and go-to-market teams. Demonstrated ability to take ambiguous, zero-to-one ideas and turn them into shipped, scaled products. Strong product judgment and systems thinking, with comfort working at the intersection of ML, infrastructure, governance, and UX. A builder’s mindset, comfortable with ambiguity, fast iteration, and learning through shipping. Strong communication skills and the ability to align senior leaders and cross-functional partners around a clear product narrative. The Opportunity

Adobe is building Firefly Foundry, the platform for customizing any media model at any depth. It spans image, video, audio, and multi-modal models, Adobe’s own and third-party alike, so all of it happens in one place. From keeping a marketing team on-brand without touching a model, to training a model that generates a studio’s characters at production quality, Firefly Foundry lets enterprises work at whatever depth the problem calls for.

We are seeking a Director of Product Management to help lead the Firefly Foundry product organization. You will drive product strategy and roadmap for key areas of the platform and partner closely with engineering, AI research, design, forward-deployed teams, product marketing, and go-to-market.

This is a rare opportunity to help shape a net-new, AI-first enterprise platform at global scale — defining how the world’s brands, studios, and developers customize, govern, and deploy generative media models, and how Firefly Foundry becomes an essential surface for enterprise AI media.

What you’ll do

  • Drive product strategy and roadmap for core areas of Firefly Foundry, spanning the platform’s levels of customization — from shared brand context and prompt intelligence to self-serve model tuning and managed franchise-model training.
  • Identify high-impact opportunities, prioritize features, define success metrics, and own end-to-end delivery across a multi-model, multi-modal platform.
  • Build a platform that lets customers start at any level of customization and go deeper as the work changes, so nothing they build at one level gets stranded when they move to the next.
  • Translate complex model-customization capabilities — fine-tuning, evals, version history, prompt intelligence, and IP guardrails — into clear, self-serve product experiences for enterprise teams.
  • Partner closely with engineering, AI research, design, and forward-deployed creative technologists, engineers, and research scientists to cut the time from an idea to a model running in production.
  • Shape how Firefly Foundry is consumed: direct API access for customers’ own applications, pipelines, and agents, and native experiences inside Firefly Studio and the Creative Cloud apps teams already use.
  • Own the trust layer as a first-class product surface — safety classifiers, jailbreak and prompt-injection defenses, copyright indemnity, data isolation, and the compliance and certifications customers inherit.
  • Contribute to Foundry’s model-agnostic strategy and token economics, keeping the best available base model one contract-free switch away for every customer.
  • Share product vision inside and outside Adobe, gathering feedback from enterprise customers, partners, and internal teams to guide direction.
  • Mentor and support product managers on the team, setting a high bar for product craft, ownership, and execution.

What you’ll need to succeed

  • 8 or more years of product management experience, including leading complex, multi-surface or platform products.
  • A strong understanding of generative media models (image, video, audio, and multi-modal) and model customization — fine-tuning, evaluation, and prompt engineering.
  • Experience building enterprise or developer platforms — APIs, SDKs, or infrastructure products serving both technical and business users.
  • Experience leading product in a matrixed organization and influencing across engineering, research, design, services, and go-to-market teams.
  • Demonstrated ability to take ambiguous, zero-to-one ideas and turn them into shipped, scaled products.
  • Strong product judgment and systems thinking, with comfort working at the intersection of ML, infrastructure, governance, and UX.
  • A builder’s mindset, comfortable with ambiguity, fast iteration, and learning through shipping.
  • Strong communication skills and the ability to align senior leaders and cross-functional partners around a clear product narrative.
  • Familiarity with enterprise trust concerns — IP protection, safety guardrails, compliance, and data governance — is a strong plus.
  • Experience with a services-plus-product or forward-deployed engagement model, or with generative AI platforms, is a strong plus.
  • Bachelor’s degree required. Advanced degree or equivalent experience preferred.

You will lead key parts of the Creative Pro offering plan within Lightroom’s overall strategy. Working closely with product managers, designers, engineers, researchers, product marketers, and advanced technology teams, you will translate real-world professional workflows into product direction, roadmap priorities, and shipped experiences. This role requires a rare combination of customer empathy, product taste, technical curiosity, strategic judgment, and senior-level influence. You will help shape how AI, agents, and new workflow innovations can make Lightroom dramatically more valuable to professional photographers while preserving craft, intent, and control. Help define how Lightroom can offer greater benefits to working photographers over the next several years. Represent professional photographers inside Adobe Serve as a trusted voice for working photographers across genres, including wedding, portrait, event, commercial, wildlife, sports, landscape, travel, editorial, and studio photography. You will represent the needs of photographers currently engaged with Lightroom, helping teams understand where pros need more speed, quality, trust, creative control, and workflow efficiency. You will lead key parts of the Creative Pro offering plan within Lightroom’s overall strategy.

Working closely with product managers, designers, engineers, researchers, product marketers, and advanced technology teams, you will translate real-world professional workflows into product direction, roadmap priorities, and shipped experiences.

This role requires a rare combination of customer empathy, product taste, technical curiosity, strategic judgment, and senior-level influence. You will help shape how AI, agents, and new workflow innovations can make Lightroom dramatically more valuable to professional photographers while preserving craft, intent, and control.

Shape the Creative Pro product agenda

  • Lead key product strategy workstreams for the Creative Pro audience across Lightroom surfaces including desktop, mobile, and web.
  • Identify high-value opportunities across professional workflows, including ingest, culling, editing, retouching, masking, batch editing, collaboration, client review, delivery, and archive.
  • Translate photographers’ jobs to be done into clear product principles, requirements, priorities, and success measures.
  • Help define how Lightroom can offer greater benefits to working photographers over the next several years.

Represent professional photographers inside Adobe

  • Serve as a trusted voice for working photographers across genres, including wedding, portrait, event, commercial, wildlife, sports, landscape, travel, editorial, and studio photography.
  • Build relationships with professional photographers, educators, creators, camera partners, and industry experts to keep Lightroom grounded in real-world workflows.
  • Bring hands-on photography fluency into product reviews, prototypes, roadmap discussions, launch planning, and executive conversations.
  • Help teams distinguish between technically impressive ideas and experiences professionals will trust in production.

Imagine and ship new experiences

  • Partner with teams in advanced technology, design, and engineering to shape new capabilities into experiences photographers love and rely on.
  • Define how AI, agents, and automation should show up in Lightroom to save time, improve quality, reduce repetitive work, and expand creative possibility.
  • Balance innovation with quality, performance, reliability, transparency, and user
  • control.
  • Drive clarity and alignment across cross-functional teams, strategic forums, planning cycles, and executive discussions.

Ground decisions in insight

AI Use Guidelines for Interviews:
Our interviews are designed to reflect your own skills and thinking. The use of AI or recording tools during live interviews is not permitted unless explicitly invited by the interviewer or approved in advance as part of a reasonable accommodation. If these tools are used inappropriately or in a way that misrepresents your work, your application may not move forward in the process.


At Adobe, we empower employees to innovate with AI — and we look for candidates eager to do the same. As part of the hiring experience, we provide clear guidance on where AI is encouraged during the process and where it’s restricted during live interviews. See how we think about AI in the hiring experience.


Expected Pay Range:

 

Our compensation reflects the cost of labor across several  U.S. geographic markets, and we pay differently based on those defined markets. The U.S. pay range for this position is $105,300 - $205,150 annually. Pay within this range varies by work location and may also depend on job-related knowledge, skills, and experience. Your recruiter can share more about the specific salary range for the job location during the hiring process.

In California, the pay range for this position is $141,700 - $205,150


At Adobe, for sales roles starting salaries are expressed as total target compensation (TTC = base + commission), and short-term incentives are in the form of sales commission plans.  Non-sales roles starting salaries are expressed as base salary and short-term incentives are in the form of the Annual Incentive Plan (AIP).

In addition, certain roles may be eligible for long-term incentives in the form of a new hire equity award.
